synthetic_structure: 320 base reasoning procedures × 32 context specializations = 10,240 unverified candidate records
important_limitations: The 10,240 generated records are scenario-specialized candidate procedures derived from 320 authored families; they are not 10,240 independently established facts or 10,240 distinct cognitive primitives.
No semantic deduplication against the local production .dcrystal vault was possible because that vault is not tracked in Git and was not available in this session.
Existing general_reasoning seeds and adjacent-domain records may overlap. Local deduplication is mandatory before import.
All generated candidates are unverified; all tests are marked not_run. No claim is made that Mirror has executed or passed these tests.
The source-supported subset is paraphrased from identified sections. Source support is not independent expert review or formal verification.
OpenStax Psychology 2e was excluded because its problem-solving chapter states that ingestion into LLMs or generative AI offerings requires OpenStax permission.
Evaluation-only data and private/local production-vault data were not used as training sources.
required_next_gates: Exact and semantic deduplication against all live vault domains
